records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Silver Ventures!
records.body:
Hi Victor,

Thanks for signing up for Wrenfield. Two things that help teams get going: create a project, and invite at least one teammate from Account Settings -> Members.

Happy to answer anything.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: New signup alert -- *Silver Ventures* just created a workspace on pro.

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to two outreach emails (email:4981db75, email:fcd41b21). No tickets, so no signal of active engagement. Silent accounts with no first project rarely self-activate within the remaining 8 days, though the Pro plan suggests some intent.

draft.subject: A hand with your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Victor,

Following up on my last note — I know early setup can slip when things are busy. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating that first project is usually the step that makes everything else click. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I can walk through the first project with you and answer anything about Silver Ventures' setup.

Best,
Priya
